Common Questions

Before your visit

Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?
We're appointment-only. Message us on WhatsApp or use the Book Now page to reserve a time that suits you.
Do you treat children as well as adults?
Yes — Forever Smiles is a family practice. We welcome patients of all ages, from a child's first check-up to full family care.
I'm nervous about dental visits — can you help?
Yes. We offer nitrous oxide sedation for patients who feel anxious in the chair. Let us know when you book and we'll talk you through it.
What should I bring to my first visit?
Just yourself and, if applicable, any previous dental records or X-rays. If you're booking for a child, their date of birth helps us prepare the right care.
Is my wisdom tooth supposed to hurt?
Impacted wisdom teeth can cause pain, swelling or crowding. Early assessment can prevent complications, so book a consultation if you're concerned.
What are your opening hours?
Monday–Wednesday & Friday 8:00am–2:30pm, Thursday 8:00am–1:00pm, Saturday 7:00am–1:00pm. Closed Sundays and holidays.
